title: finding(app-shell/inspectors,i18n): the designer's unknown-value markers are hard-coded English while the translated key already exists and is used elsewhere - a zh-CN author reads untranslated text on a translated surface
body:
Dedup keywords: `unknownValueLabel` · `notInObject` · `designer marker` · `untranslated literal` · `inspector i18n`

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#8862 (PR objectui#9650); filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat. ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, ⛔ **no `domain:*` applied** — routing is the triage seat's.

## The defect

`ViewColumnInspector` passes a **hard-coded English literal** as its unknown-value marker:

```
unknownValueLabel={(v) => `${v} (not in object)`}
```

⚠️ Meanwhile the key **`engine.form.notInObject` already exists in the catalogue in BOTH locales**, and is already consumed by `widgets.tsx`. ⇒ the translation exists, is maintained, and this surface simply does not reach for it.

⭐ Not one site — the same shape repeats with different literals:

| site | literal |
|:--|:--|
| `ViewColumnInspector` | `(not in object)` |
| `ViewVariantInspector` | `(not found)` |
| `FlowNodeConfigField` | `(deprecated)` |

⇒ a **zh-CN author reads untranslated English on an otherwise translated surface**, in the designer, on a marker whose whole job is to explain why a value looks wrong.

## Why this is class (a) rather than a style nit

The marker is **user-visible text on a shipped surface**, it is **wrong for every non-English locale**, and the correct machinery is **already present and already used one file over**. ⛔ Nothing is missing except the call. That makes it a reproducible defect with a named fix, not a preference.

⚠️ ⛔ What this card does **not** assume: whether all three literals should route to the same key, whether `(not found)` and `(deprecated)` have keys of their own, and whether the `(v) => …` callback shape survives translation (word order is not guaranteed to put the value first in every locale). ⭐ That last one is the interesting part and is why this is not a three-line mechanical edit.

## Provenance

objectui#8862 dev report `5707465871`; seat ACCEPT on that card. ⚠️ The catalogue and consumer readings are the dev's — ⛔ this seat has **not** re-run them. Re-derive before acting.

⛔ This seat did not run a dedup query. Dedup words are at the top.
